resources.title: MCP servers
resources.subtitle: Upstream MCP servers Coffer aggregates and re-exposes through a single shim.

welcome.title: A local-first vault for the AI assets your editors share
welcome.body: Register your first MCP server below — Coffer keeps it running locally and re-exposes its tools to every connected client under one namespace.

featureAggregate.title: Aggregate, don't fragment
featureAggregate.body: One client connection covers every upstream MCP server you register.

featureCurate.title: Curate, don't dump
featureCurate.body: Per-capability toggles persist across daemon restarts and upstream upgrades.

featureLocal.title: Local-first
featureLocal.body: The vault binds 127.0.0.1; nothing leaves your machine without an explicit surface.

mcp.missingRunner: {{runner}} is not installed on this machine

server.addSubtitle: Register an upstream MCP server — Coffer starts it on first use and re-exposes its tools.
server.deleteConfirmBody: This removes the server registration and all associated capability preferences. The audit + invocation log entries are preserved.

capabilities.emptyTool: No tools discovered from this upstream yet.
capabilities.emptyResource: No resources discovered from this upstream yet.
capabilities.emptyPrompt: No prompts discovered from this upstream yet.
capabilities.loadError: Couldn't load capabilities from this upstream — it may be unreachable. Try Test connection, then Refresh capabilities.

import.jsonHelp: Paste the JSON from an MCP server's README — the standard {"mcpServers": {…}} format. Multiple servers are imported at once.
import.secretHint: Values marked Secret are encrypted into Coffer's local database; the rest stay in the config.
import.errNoServers: Couldn't find an MCP server. Expected the {"mcpServers": {…}} format.
import.errBadEnvValue: Server "{{name}}" env variable "{{key}}" must be a string.
import.errEnvNotObject: Server "{{name}}" env must be an object of string values.

edit.title: Edit MCP server
edit.subtitle: Update this server's description, configuration, and credentials.
edit.configHint: Credentials are managed below, not in this JSON.
edit.credentialHint: Credential values are encrypted into Coffer's local database. Removing a credential deletes its stored entry.
edit.errRenameNeedsValue: Re-enter the secret value for "{{name}}" to rename it.

tiering.summary: Agents see {{listed}} of {{total}} tools; {{hidden}} are reachable only through coffer__search_tools.
tiering.hint: They stay callable by name. Set COFFER_TOOL_TIERING=off to list every tool.

timeouts.requestHint: One call to this server. 5–1800, default 120.
timeouts.idleHint: Before an unused connection closes. 60–86400, default 600.

general.title: Display
general.pageSizeHelp: The initial page size for every table.
general.preferredEditorHelp: The editor Coffer opens managed files with. Pick a detected editor, or type any app name / launch command. Empty uses the system default.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.pruneDescription: Apply the current retention policies immediately.

conversations_archive.name: Auto-archive idle chats
conversations_archive.description: Archive conversations with no new message for this many days.

conversations.name: Delete archived chats
conversations.description: Delete archived conversations this many days after archival (with their messages).

embedding.title: Embedding
embedding.description: One global embedding model powers vector search across every knowledge base and memory store. Turn it off to use keyword and grep only.
embedding.enabledHint: When off, all stores fall back to keyword/grep.
embedding.empty: No embedding model configured — vector retrieval falls back to keyword/grep.
embedding.changeModelConfirm: Changing the embedding model re-embeds all content in every knowledge base and memory store, which may take a while. Continue?
embedding.dimensionsFixed: Set automatically from the selected model.
embedding.secretKeepBlank: Leave blank to keep the current key
embedding.credentialHint: Credential store entry name (not the key itself)
embedding.chunkingHint: Default chunk size/overlap for NEW knowledge bases. Each knowledge base can override these in its settings.

masterKey.title: Credential encryption
masterKey.description: Secrets are always encrypted into Coffer's local database. This controls where the encryption master key lives.
masterKey.fileNote: Master key: file beside the database (no keychain prompts).
masterKey.keychainNote: Master key: OS keychain (may prompt once per daemon start).
masterKey.toggle: Store master key in OS keychain

models.title: Models
models.subtitle: Coffer's internal model — powers tool/knowledge retrieval and the knowledge organizer.
models.deleteConfirm: Delete model "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
models.empty: No models configured yet. Add one to start chatting.
models.fetchedCount: {{count}} models fetched — pick one or type your own

sync.title: Export / import vault
sync.description: Write this vault into a directory you pick, or read one back. Carrying that directory to your other machine — scp, a USB drive, your own git repo — is up to you.
sync.withCredentialsHint: Credentials travel as encrypted ciphertext, never the master key. Leave this off unless the other machine needs them — an export directory is easy to leave somewhere careless.
sync.bundlePathManualHint: This machine has no native folder dialog — type the path, then click again.
sync.masterKeyHint: Export this machine's key to a file and move it to another machine over a channel you trust, then import it there. It is never written into an export bundle.
sync.keyFingerprintHint: Matching fingerprints on two machines mean they hold the same key.
sync.keyImported: Key imported — this machine now decrypts credentials brought with a bundle.
sync.keyFileEmpty: That file is empty — pick the key file exported from the other machine.

connections.title: Model providers
connections.subtitle: A model provider = a vendor endpoint and its API key. One provider can drive your agents and Coffer's internal engine.
connections.secretKeepBlank: Leave blank to keep the current key
connections.compatibleAgentsHint: Which coding agents this provider can drive. Pick the provider per agent on its Overview tab.
connections.deleteConfirm: Delete model provider "{{name}}"? Its stored credential is removed too.
connections.name: Name
connections.bulkDeleteConfirm: Delete {{count}} model provider(s)? Their stored credentials are removed too.

detail.modelsHint: Pick which of this endpoint's models this provider offers. The agent's model picker is then limited to your picks.
detail.unrestricted: No restriction — every model this endpoint offers is available.
detail.restricted: {{count}} model(s) picked — agents see only these.
detail.fetchFailed: Could not list this endpoint's models ({{error}}). Your current selection is unchanged.
detail.noModelsYet: No models yet — fetch this endpoint's models, or leave it unrestricted.

internalEngine.title: Internal engine
internalEngine.subtitle: The model provider and model Coffer's own LLM engine (memory organizer / reorg) runs on. The provider supplies the endpoint + key; the model is chosen separately here.

offline.title: Daemon offline
offline.body: The coffer daemon stopped responding. Capability lists, tool calls, and registrations will fail until it restarts.
offline.notReadyBody: Coffer's background service isn't reachable yet. It usually starts on its own and this notice clears itself once it does; if the problem continues, restart Coffer.
offline.webRestartHint: The browser can't restart it — run this in your terminal:

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.subtitle: No route matches {{path}}.
notFound.bodyTitle: You might have followed a stale link
notFound.body: If you typed the URL by hand, double-check it. Otherwise jump back to the resources list — every Coffer page is reachable from the sidebar.

errors.PRIVILEGED_PATH: That path is privileged and can't be used here
errors.PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_SOURCE_INVALID: Supply exactly one of a saved credential or an inline key
errors.RESOURCE_ALREADY_EXISTS: A resource with that name already exists
errors.SCOPE_INVALID: That scope isn't valid for this resource kind
errors.SCOPE_UNRESOLVED: The memory scope couldn't be resolved
errors.SHIM_NOT_FOUND: Couldn't find the coffer-mcp-shim binary. Install Coffer so the shim is on PATH, or set COFFER_MCP_SHIM_PATH.
errors.SKILL_FILE_STALE: The skill file changed on disk since you loaded it. Reload and retry.
errors.SKILL_OUT_OF_SCOPE: This skill isn't in scope for this agent on this machine

errors.SYNC_BUNDLE_TOO_NEW: That bundle was written by a newer Coffer; upgrade before importing
errors.SYNC_SERIALIZATION_INVALID: That bundle's contents could not be read

errors.TURN_IN_PROGRESS: A turn is already in progress in this conversation

welcome.title: Manage your local AI agents
welcome.body: Register the AI agents installed on your machine. View their config files, and install Coffer's MCP server into them in one click.

featureDetect.title: Auto-detect
featureDetect.body: Coffer scans common install paths and shows the agents it finds — you choose which to add.

featureConfig.title: Config files
featureConfig.body: View each agent's config files in Coffer, read-only.

featureMcp.title: One-click MCP
featureMcp.body: Install Coffer's MCP server into an agent with a single click.

featureImport.body: Bring in a local skill folder from disk.

featureDrift.body: Verify that every enabled binding still matches its on-disk link.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.subtitle: One local knowledge store per scope — what your agents write and what you upload — searchable through the MCP gateway. The global and per-project scopes are created automatically.
knowledge.empty: No knowledge scopes yet. Create a collection, or let the global and per-project scopes appear as your agents work.
knowledge.noMatches: No knowledge scopes match your search.

rename.title: Rename knowledge scope
rename.description: Give this scope a readable display name. This is a label only — it doesn't change the scope's id or where agents read and write.
rename.label: Display name

dialog.title: New knowledge collection
dialog.description: A collection you curate yourself. The global and per-project scopes appear on their own — you never create those by hand.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.nameHint: Letters, digits, dash and underscore. "global" and names starting with "project-" are reserved for the automatic scopes.

detail.selectEntry: Select a note on the left to preview it.
detail.emptyDocuments: No documents yet. Upload a file of any format to populate this scope.
detail.selectDocument: Select a document on the left to preview it.
detail.degradedBadge: {{count}} documents pending vector embed (embedding service unavailable; indexed by keyword)
detail.clearConfirm: Clear every note in {{scope}}? Its uploaded documents are untouched. This cannot be undone.
detail.deleteEntryConfirm: Delete note {{name}}? This cannot be undone.
detail.deleteDocConfirm: Delete document {{title}}? This cannot be undone.

sourceCheck.title: Source files
sourceCheck.description: Documents ingested from a file on disk, checked against their original source.
sourceCheck.empty: No documents track an external source file. Web uploads aren't tracked — only documents ingested from a path (via the CLI) have a source file to re-check.
sourceCheck.updated: Document updated from its source file.
sourceCheck.missingNote: Source file not found at that path.
sourceCheck.editedNote: This document was edited locally, so updating from source is blocked to avoid clobbering your changes.

settings.title: Knowledge scope settings
settings.description: Update chunking and retrieval for this scope. Reindex afterwards to apply chunking changes to existing documents.
settings.vectorHint: Add meaning-based vector retrieval for this scope (keyword + grep are always on). The embedding model is configured globally in Settings → Embedding.
settings.autoUpdateSourcesHint: When a document's external source file changes, re-ingest it automatically on the next source check (locally edited documents are always skipped).

welcome.title: One place for everything your agents know
welcome.body: A global scope, one per project, plus any collection you make — holding both the notes agents write and the documents you upload. Everything stays on your machine as plain Markdown.

featureEntries.title: What agents write
featureEntries.body: Agents store and recall what they learn across sessions, through Coffer's built-in MCP tools.

featureDocuments.title: What you ingest
featureDocuments.body: Upload a file of any format; Coffer converts it to Markdown and indexes it for search.

featureLocal.title: Local-first
featureLocal.body: Everything is plain Markdown on your machine; the index rebuilds from the files.

knowledge.deleteScopeConfirm: Delete knowledge scope "{{name}}"? Its notes, documents and index are removed. This cannot be undone.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Connect the IM accounts you already use — Telegram and SeaTalk — to your agents.

welcome.title: Talk to your agents from the IM apps you live in
welcome.body: A channel connects one Telegram bot or SeaTalk app to Coffer's chat platform. Pair it with your own account, then message the bot to chat with an agent — replies and notifications all arrive in the IM chat.

featureChat.title: Chat anywhere
featureChat.body: Messages route into an ordinary conversation; the agent's reply comes back to the IM chat.

featurePair.title: Paired to you only
featurePair.body: A single-use pairing code binds the channel to your account; strangers are ignored silently.

featureNotify.title: Push notifications
featureNotify.body: Coffer can push a message to the paired owner — no inbound message required.

dialog.title: Add channel
dialog.subtitle: Secrets are stored in Coffer's credential store; the channel config only carries references.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.telegramHint: The token BotFather gave you for the bot.
dialog.seatalkHint: App ID, App Secret, and Signing Secret from the SeaTalk Open Platform app.
dialog.publicBaseUrlHint: Optional. Your tunnel's public address (e.g. https://xxx.trycloudflare.com). Coffer composes the full callback URL from it for you to register on the SeaTalk Open Platform.
dialog.tunnelTokenHint: Optional. With a cloudflared named-tunnel connector token here, Coffer starts and keeps the tunnel running while the channel is enabled (cloudflared must be installed, and the tunnel's Cloudflare ingress must point at http://127.0.0.1:8787).

edit.title: Edit channel
edit.subtitle: Change the bound agent or rotate a secret. Leave a secret field blank to keep the current value.
edit.agentHint: New conversations on this channel start on this agent.
edit.rotateHint: Stored in Coffer's credential store; the existing reference is reused.

test.title: Send test message
test.subtitle: Push a one-off message to the paired peer to confirm delivery works.
test.needsPeer: Pair the channel first — there is no peer to notify yet.

pairing.title: Pairing
pairing.instruction: Generate a code, then send it to the bot from your own account. The sender becomes this channel's sole owner — re-pairing replaces the previous one.

callback.title: SeaTalk callback
callback.registerUrl: Callback URL to register on SeaTalk
callback.setBaseUrlHint: Set your tunnel's public base URL in Edit, and the full callback URL to register on SeaTalk will appear here.
callback.hint: Point a tunnel (cloudflared, ngrok) at the local listener address. The reachability test verifies the path and handshake; whether the signing secret matches SeaTalk's is confirmed only on a real event.

channels.deleteConfirm: Delete channel “{{name}}”? Its adapter stops and the pairing is removed.

scope.subtitle: Which agents this is active for — every agent, or only the ones you select. Out of scope it stays registered, just not exposed or delivered.
scope.dormant: No agent selected — dormant. This stays registered but reaches no agent until you select at least one below.
